text: `mmio_load [iN] p` and `mmio_store p v` shall accept integer types matching the pointer pointee and explicitly supported contract widths. Non-byte widths shall have an explicit value/transaction-bit mapping, including ignored/required bits. Ordinary iN storage rules shall not imply that mapping.
